statement: Counter-example: the same corpus reported as a lone headline percentage, with no per-tier counts and no statement of which tiers were treated as trusted. A consumer cannot tell 50% authored from 50% attested, and cannot audit the numerator at all.
note: Non-conformant: `by_provenance`, `golden_tiers`, `golden_count` and `total_intent` are all absent. Rejecting this output is the test.
